usage: music-tagger checklist [-h] [--file FILE] {next,done,skip,reopen} ...

Read and update the album checklist.

positional arguments:
  {next,done,skip,reopen}
    next                Show the next unchecked album.
    done                Mark an album done.
    skip                Mark an album skipped, with the reason.
    reopen              Uncheck an album, or every skip matching text.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --file FILE           Checklist file (default: $MUSIC_TAGGER_CHECKLIST, else
                        ~/Projects/music-tagger/checklist.md).
